home.heroSubtitle: Explore the island on your own terms. Free delivery anywhere in Djerba, helmet and equipment included, from 60 TND a day.
home.whySubtitle: The things that actually matter when you are on holiday.
home.why1Text: To your hotel, to Djerba-Zarzis airport or to your rental: we come to you at no extra cost, at a time that suits you.
home.why2Text: The quoted rate includes the helmet and all equipment. Nothing is added when you hand the scooter back.
home.why3Text: Our scooters are regularly serviced. If anything goes wrong we intervene immediately, anywhere on the island.
home.why4Text: One WhatsApp message is enough. No online payment: you pay cash on delivery, in euro, dollar or dinar.
home.howSubtitle: Three steps and you are riding.
home.how1Text: Send us the scooter you want and your dates by WhatsApp or through the form. We confirm availability quickly.
home.how2Text: We deliver the scooter to you anywhere in Djerba, with the helmet and all equipment.
home.how3Text: You pay cash on delivery, and the island is yours. We stay reachable for the whole rental.
home.zonesSubtitle: Free of charge, wherever you are staying on the island.
home.faqSubtitle: Everything worth knowing before you book.
home.ctaText: Tell us your dates and we handle the rest. We reply within minutes.
home.intro: Locascoot Djerba rents scooters across the whole island of Djerba. Whether you are staying in Houmt Souk, Midoun, the tourist zone, Aghir, or arriving at Djerba-Zarzis airport, we deliver your scooter free of charge to the address and time of your choice. A helmet and full equipment come with every rental, and we intervene immediately in case of a breakdown.

prices.title: Rental prices in Djerba
prices.subtitle: Price per day, all inclusive. Helmet, full equipment, assistance and free delivery come with every rental.
prices.tableNote: Price per day in Tunisian dinar (TND). The euro figure is indicative and depends on the day’s exchange rate.
prices.depositText: A deposit is taken when the vehicle is handed over and returned in full when you bring it back in the condition you received it. The amount depends on the model and is shown in the table above.
prices.paymentText: No online payment is required. You pay in cash when the scooter is delivered, in euro (€), dollar ($) or Tunisian dinar (TND).
prices.documentsText: A national ID card or passport is required for any rental. For the 125cc scooter, a valid driving licence is also required. The minimum age is 18.
